title: The public home page opens on the march out of Fort Dearborn
items: The first picture under the home page's opening film is now the garrison and the families marching out of Fort Dearborn in 1812, each with their name over their head.
The Kimball household at 1801 Prairie moves to the People page, beside the person cards it shows off.
The 1812 row on the home page now runs from the order to leave to the burning.
